required_features: Gigabit Ethernet full duplex (1 Gbit/s nominal per direction)
USB 3 device and 5 V power via one detachable USB-C cable
AP6256 Wi-Fi internal dual-band antenna standard, external U.FL optional via exclusive assembly selection; below-gigabit throughput accepted

usb_power_target.scope: Base gateway with display and Wi-Fi active; optional expansion power requires a separate budget
usb_power_target.required_source_profiles: 5 V USB Type-C with 1.5 A or 3 A advertised
usb_power_target.qualification: Open: existing main-load enable requires a 3 A advertisement. Verify rail budgets, converter losses, inrush, transients and USB-C current detection before changing the enable circuit.

ram_selection_status: Existing implemented 1 GiB LPDDR4; 512 MiB cost study unqualified; no new memory selection authorized by this processor decision
performance_qualification: Gigabit Ethernet/USB3 full-duplex design target; no measured RK3562 VPN or end-to-end throughput guarantee
internal_antenna_status: W3006 circuit/footprint candidate verified; placement and active-board integration pending, see migration-rk3562/experiments/internal-antenna/checkpoint.json
